title: Research Assistant
org: Aarhus University — Dept. of Business Development and Technology (BTECH)
points: Headhunted by Associate Professor Eva Sørum Poulsen and Professor Mirko Pressor at BTECH for this temporary position.

points.text: Supervising three MSc in Engineering student projects:
sub: Using unstructured data to generate process diagrams that support the PMO side of projects spanning disparate systems and cross-department collaboration.
A multivocal literature review of state-of-the-art context-engineering methods and their impact on researchers and practitioners.
AI adoption and governance — producing recommendations for the safe use of AI in a security firm.

points: Developing an AI course assistant that answers students' questions from the course material, for bachelor's and master's programmes.

Designed and facilitated a professional AI workshop using the 33A AI Cards® methodology, teaching master's students to architect structured AI business cases and identify high-value automation opportunities.
Together with the company EIVA, built an internal AI assistant for customer service that finds answers in large technical manuals and past support tickets.
Designed an open-source AI tool that helps researchers review academic literature transparently, for the OSSYM 2026 conference at CODE University, Berlin.

title: Student Worker — Digitalization
org: The LEGO Group — Mould Engineering Enabling & Technology
points: Built 15+ business apps (Power Apps) and 50+ automated workflows (Power Automate) as a citizen developer.
Managed how apps were built, tested and released on the Power Platform — in the 10th largest environment at The LEGO Group.
Took an AI chatbot from prototype towards a real product, searching all core documentation for element, mould development and mould construction — used by 331 engineers.
Built and scaled automated engineering newsletters, tailored to each reader's chosen topics.
Facilitator of the TDC specialist community (30–40 people).
Documented rework quality (ISO 9001) for moulds for 10 months.
Technical Product Owner of 50+ SharePoint sites for Mould Engineering for 10 months.
Worked on a machine-learning initiative using image recognition to support mould designers.
Managed the split of a large form-processing process from one department into two.
Planned and carried out the move of 50 automated workflows and 30 apps as part of a digital transition.

title: Student Instructor — Web Technologies
points: Instructed undergraduate students in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP and MySQL.
Received an average student evaluation of 4.9 / 5 on teaching the material.
